workflows.label: Evaluate the same explicit case as the GUI
workflows.guidance: Read the provider problem schema. Use problem.physics.provider and problem.physics.problem in the explicit case. Use an empty design for evaluation-only providers. For design providers, supply each coordinate with value, lower, upper, and designable fields. Match their array shapes. Use evaluate_results for the saved model-bound problem. Check provider limits before use.

workflows.label: Move a picked surface through editable parameters
workflows.guidance: Check model authority before a drag. Supply a picked surface point in world millimeters. Read the session and candidate parameters. Start preview sequence at zero. Increase it for each preview. Measure displacement from the gesture start. Check accepted values before commit. Cancel to restore the starting model. Run preflight after commit. Use a linked branch during optimizer intervention.

workflows.label: Save physics settings for the inspected geometry
workflows.guidance: Copy structure_id and content_id from inspect_state.model into expected_model. Save the provider problem with that identity. If the identity differs, review the model before a new save. Run model-aware preflight after the save.

workflows.label: Read stored spatial or history results
workflows.guidance: Set stream=true for result evaluation. Read field_arrays with read_result_array. Use chunks of at most 4096 elements. Use flattened C-order offsets, not byte offsets. Count each complex pair as one element. Keep shape, units, registration, and state identity. Do not treat time-history arrays as spatial grids.

workflows.label: Reuse an exact state as a guarded Newton guess
workflows.guidance: Set exact_state_handoff.produce=true on exact evaluation. Pass capsule_id through exact_state_handoff.consume for sensitivity or optimization. Use each capsule once. The receiver solves and checks the state again. Changes to design, problem, runtime, time grid, or tolerances invalidate the capsule. Do not use a capsule as a stored result.

workflows.label: Standalone geometry and explicit physics activation
workflows.guidance: Load required installed packages. Do not change package selection while a job owns it.

workflows.label: Inspect before acting
workflows.guidance: Read state before an action and after a change.

workflows.label: Targets to automatic multiphysics
workflows.guidance: Use declared couplings and boundary roles. Do not invent a solver sequence.

workflows.label: Manual engineering followed by direct-gradient optimization
workflows.guidance: Use the same implicit model for manual edits and optimization.

workflows.label: Intervene in a running optimization
workflows.guidance: Enter intervention mode first. Save a branch point. Commit the manual change. Continue with branch_after_intervention to calculate new physics and gradients.

workflows.label: Turn a manual deformation cage into shape optimization
workflows.guidance: Reuse the committed cage. Check exact derivative support for its promoted coordinate.

workflows.label: Compare engineering alternatives
workflows.guidance: Set variants and a calculation budget. Rank only completed variants with valid physics.

workflows.label: Export watertight STL files of the model or an epoch
workflows.guidance: Read registered fields with inspect_renderables. Select the current model or a published epoch. Set material thresholds in increasing order. Supply one more material ID than thresholds. Add complement to export the surrounding volume. Read checks.passed before use. STL lengths are in millimeters. These mesh checks do not prove manufacturing suitability.

workflows.label: Build a parametric implicit model
workflows.guidance: Use registered geometry types and parameter units. Set dimensions and expressions through declared graph operations.

workflows.label: Edit an implicit volume
workflows.guidance: Check each preview before commit. Cancel to restore the starting state. Use shared history for undo and redo.

workflows.label: Import a mesh as an implicit volume
workflows.guidance: Supply a closed STL or PLY mesh. Set input units and field sampling. Read interpolation measurements. Validate the resulting implicit model before physics setup.

workflows.label: Use an external physics model
workflows.guidance: Check adapter predictions and design derivatives. Select the adapter explicitly. Remove it only when no job owns it.

workflows.label: Compare saved optimization epochs
workflows.guidance: Read published epochs for each job. Prepare their common epochs. Select solid, complement, or retained fields through the declared render schemas. Keep operating-point identities with fields. Use read_optimization_epoch_field for retained values. Do not calculate interpolated scientific states.

workflows.label: Run an isolated physics calculation
workflows.guidance: Keep the operation identity. Read its state before another submission. Use its declared cancellation tool.

workflows.label: Export implicit geometry
workflows.guidance: Select the implicit node or published epoch. Set format, units, and sampling through the tool schema. Read mesh checks before use. STEP uses planar facets of the sampled surface.

safety_rules: Check pressure-wave and fatigue solver limits. Quasistatic histories do not resolve resonance.
Check solver convergence and gradients before using results.
Run preflight after geometry, boundary, material, or physics changes. Recalculate physical states and gradients.
Get host permission before branch restoration. Restoration replaces the current model.
Report missing material data or unavailable physics. Do not substitute guessed values.

recovery.guidance: Reconnect and get the tool list. Read the model and job states. Compare their identities with the saved request. Do not repeat a change until its outcome is known. Report an unknown outcome before further changes.
Read the manual and tool list again. Compare current model identities with the intended model. Review differences before a new request. Do not replace expected_model without that review.

Read numerical_attention, event_token, limits, and available actions. Use retry_exact or discard only when permitted. Use branch_after_numerical_attention for continue_exploratory. Keep the exploratory branch separate from validated results. Use only the current event token.
Read the parent job until the child identity appears or the event reopens. Do not submit another resolution. Follow the returned child identity.

Read the current job after reconnecting. Check that its state permits resume. Do not treat a missing or terminal job as paused. Use the declared recovery path. A geometry import does not restore optimizer history.

actions.name: render_3d
actions.label: Render implicit surface in 3D
actions.description: Render the current model, a saved epoch, or a registered result field. Set camera, clipping, coloring, and quality through the schema. Use native quality only with a declared analysis grid. Capped cuts change the display only.

region.description: solid (default) draws the model's solid; complement draws the region outside the solid but inside the known model extent (e.g. a fluid domain), closed at the extent faces. Solid and complement are always separate renders; requires surface_field model_boundary

surface_color_rgb.description: uniform display colour of the surface (and of solid section-cap points); excludes color_field

color_stops.description: explicit piecewise-linear colouring of color_field: strictly increasing values, sRGB interpolation, end colours held outside; replaces palette/value_range

color_categories.description: explicit threshold categories for color_field, evaluated per pixel after interpolation; one fewer increasing threshold than categories; replaces palette/value_range

cap.description: fill the cut plane where the view ray reaches it before any kept surface: points inside the sampled solid take the surface colouring, complement points (within the known model extent) take complement_color_rgb; without it the complement stays open

inside.description: solid side of iso_value; auto is below_iso for model_boundary and above_iso for registered fields

antialias.description: supersampling factor k: rasterize at k x the image size and box-filter in linear light; raster pixels are bounded to 8388608

quality.description: preview..high cap samples per axis; geometry samples at the finest spacing the source declares (node geometry lattice or field registration), geometry_fine at half of it; native/analysis use a registered cell lattice without resampling

exact_state_handoff.description: Optional exact-worker acceleration. A capsule is only a one-shot matching-time Newton guess, never an authoritative solved state or cache hit.

computation_effort.description: User-settable computational effort and approximation tolerance. Exact is the safe default. staged and interactive select bounded, exact-corrected interactive lane without requiring expert settings. Provider, registry, session, authority, operation-context and truth fields are server-owned and unavailable here.

preset.description: Simple mutually exclusive preset. staged uses the provider's conservative lagged-coupling initializer; interactive uses its minimum-work initializer. Both exactly correct before commit. fast is a compatibility alias for interactive.

wall_time_mode.description: Explicit unlimited elapsed time requires null wall_time_s and a positive memory_bytes limit; omission retains parent defaults.

coupling_approximation.description: Optional provider-owned initialization policy. Explicit IDs must be advertised as safely laggable by the selected provider; all couplings are restored for mandatory exact correction.

step_fraction.title: Initial trust step
step_fraction.description: First trust step: largest per-entry change of a trial.

move_limit.title: Per-update move limit

minimum_step_fraction.description: Backtracking stops below this step; at most the initial step and the move limit.

backtracking.title: Backtracking factor

armijo.title: Sufficient-decrease coefficient

step_growth.title: Trust-step growth
step_growth.description: The trust step grows by this factor after an accepted step.

stationarity_tolerance.title: Stationarity tolerance
stationarity_tolerance.unit: relative to the first projected-gradient norm
stationarity_tolerance.description: Projected-gradient max-norm, relative to its first value, at which a stage is stationary.

bound_tolerance.title: Bound tolerance
bound_tolerance.description: Admissible scaled bound violation/complementarity for convergence.

penalty_growth.title: Penalty growth
penalty_growth.description: A bound's penalty grows by this factor when its violation does not shrink enough.

penalty_limit.title: Penalty limit
penalty_limit.description: No penalty exceeds this multiple of its initial value 2*weight.

violation_reduction.title: Required violation reduction
violation_reduction.description: Penalties grow unless the bound measure fell below this factor times its previous value.

multiplier_update_interval.title: Multiplier update interval
multiplier_update_interval.description: Multipliers are also updated after this many accepted steps.

gradient_clip_norm.title: Retired gradient clipping
gradient_clip_norm.description: 'gradient_clip_norm' no longer exists: the search direction is the max-norm-normalised projected gradient and the carried trust step, bounded by 'move_limit', sets every update; remove the key or set it to null

step_policy.title: Step policy
step_policy.description: Fixed-step direct gradient descent evaluates one candidate per epoch. Backtracking uses sufficient-decrease trials.

update_metric.description: Positive cross-family update scaling. Omission defaults to gradient_adaptive alpha=0.5; global_max remains available explicitly. gradient_adaptive interpolates with alpha between shared and per-family bound-gradient RMS (0.5 is recommended); family_balanced is alpha=1. Provider step scales are not cancelled. Move limits, coordinate boxes and the exact line search remain authoritative.

design_coordinates.description: Explicit variable-family declarations. Omit to use every provider-declared family. A saved-region list limits only where that family may react.

designable_selection_ids.description: Exact saved viewport region IDs. Selections must be current and share the coordinate's registered grid.

coordinate_masks.description: Per-coordinate exact design domains. Values may use designable, designable_ref, or current designable_selection_ids; omitted coordinates remain fully designable except provider-protected regions.

actions.name: optimization_operation
actions.label: Operate optimization job
actions.description: Pause, intervene, resume, stop, accept, or discard a job. Use view=monitor to omit large arrays.

actions.name: use_optimization_result
actions.label: Use result as working design
actions.description: Copy a saved epoch into an editable model with expected identity checks. Source results remain unchanged. Check engineering targets separately.

epoch.description: Saved epoch; omitted selects the latest available checkpoint, not the best feasible result.

actions.name: steer_optimization
actions.label: Steer fixed optimization parameters
actions.description: Queue a fixed-parameter change at the next epoch boundary. Read its acknowledgement before another change. Free coordinates cannot be changed this way.

request.description: Exact GUI steering body: set maps model references to values, or parameters maps unambiguous fixed parameter names to values. Manager classification remains authoritative.

actions.name: branch_after_intervention
actions.label: Continue optimization as a branch
actions.description: Continue an intervened job as a linked child branch. Use view=monitor to omit large arrays.

actions.name: resolve_numerical_attention
actions.label: Resolve numerical deviation
actions.description: Resolve the current numerical event with a permitted retry or discard. An exact retry retains equations, tolerances, and validity checks.

actions.name: branch_after_numerical_attention
actions.label: Continue numerical deviation as exploratory branch
actions.description: Start a linked exploratory branch within the provider deviation limit. Keep its results separate from validated results.

actions.name: save_branch_point
actions.label: Save engineering branch point
actions.description: Save engineering branch point.

details.description: Branch-point metadata, including objective_setup, as saved by the GUI. This does not capture physics conditions or apply objectives.

actions.name: restore_branch_point
actions.label: Restore engineering branch point
actions.description: Restore engineering branch point.

actions.name: interaction_field
actions.label: Inspect editable geometry field or native components
actions.description: Inspect editable geometry field or native components.

actions.name: interaction_history_state
actions.label: Read shared manual command history and revision-bound undo heads
actions.description: Read shared manual command history and revision-bound undo heads.

actions.name: interaction_capabilities
actions.label: Inspect shared viewport editing contract
actions.description: Inspect shared viewport editing contract.

actions.name: interaction_begin
actions.label: Begin transactional geometry, field or cage interaction
actions.description: Start transactional geometry, field or cage interaction.

field_id.description: Exact field/component id returned by interaction_field; a native component identifies its volume for geometry sculpt.

input_schema.description: Begin the same atomic authoring transaction used by the GUI. geometry_sculpt writes the existing model:control authority without mesh baking. Use interaction_capabilities for tools and representation limits.

actions.name: interaction_preview
actions.label: Preview field or cage interaction
actions.description: Preview field or cage interaction.

operation.description: For geometry_sculpt: tool grab/stretch/twist/scale/bend/taper/inflate/deflate/smooth/add/subtract/flatten/protect/release/select; center_mm XYZ; radius_mm; optional depth_mm, normal, direction, delta_mm, amount_mm, factor, angle_rad, strength in [0,1], points_mm polyline, scope local/box/whole, bounds_mm min_mm/max_mm, symmetry_axes, symmetry_origin_mm, carry_phase, protect_phase, protection geometry/controls, hardness in [0,0.95], pivot_mm, bend_direction perpendicular to direction, axial_length_mm. Reusable authoring masks: tool select, selection_id (default main), selection_action replace/add/subtract/intersect/invert/all/clear. Subsequent edits use use_selection true with that selection_id. A selection is not an optimizer hold. See native_tools for exclusions. All coordinates are model mm. The stroke is recomputed from its immutable baseline, not accumulated previews.

input_schema.description: Preview only. Inspect accepted and evidence, then commit exactly the acknowledged final sequence.

actions.name: interaction_commit
actions.label: Commit field or cage interaction
actions.description: Commit field or cage interaction.

input_schema.description: Commit precisely the acknowledged preview and invalidate old physics evidence. A fresh preflight is required before optimization.

actions.name: interaction_cancel
actions.label: Cancel field or cage interaction
actions.description: Cancel field or cage interaction.

input_schema.description: Cancel the active field/cage transaction.

actions.name: interaction_refine
actions.label: Refine an exact surface pick
actions.description: Refine an exact surface pick.

input_schema.description: Native exact surface-pick refinement request, including point_mm and optional model_identity.

actions.name: interaction_undo
actions.label: Undo field or cage interaction
actions.description: Undo field or cage interaction.

input_schema.description: Shared manual history, including parameter gestures. Read interaction_history_state first and supply both expected fields to reject concurrent edits. Empty requests retain legacy immediate-head behavior.

actions.name: interaction_redo
actions.label: Redo field or cage interaction
actions.description: Redo field or cage interaction.

input_schema.description: Shared manual history, including parameter gestures. Read interaction_history_state first and supply both expected fields to reject concurrent edits. Empty requests retain legacy immediate-head behavior.

actions.name: manipulation_begin
actions.label: Begin direct geometry manipulation
actions.description: Start direct geometry manipulation.

input_schema.description: Begin a parameter-driven surface drag on the current model. Returns a session and ordered editable parameters; does not start physics.

node.description: Existing node identifier; omission selects the model root.

point_mm.description: Picked world-space surface point, XYZ in mm.

normal.description: Optional orientation hint; the field gradient supplies the normal.

parameters.description: Named parameters or node:<node_id>:<parameter> references. Omission/empty list discovers candidates in the subtree.

actions.name: manipulation_preview
actions.label: Preview direct geometry manipulation
actions.description: Preview direct geometry manipulation.

input_schema.description: Update the live, uncommitted model. Displacement is measured from the gesture start, not the previous preview. Use increasing sequence numbers and inspect accepted before commit.

displacement_mm.description: World XYZ displacement in mm; takes precedence if normal_delta_mm is also supplied.

normal_delta_mm.description: Signed displacement along the session normal, in mm.

locked.description: One flag per returned candidate, in the returned order.

parameter_weights.description: Weights in returned candidate order; interpreted by the drag solver.

semantic_parameter.description: Exact key from the returned candidates, selecting single-parameter editing.

parameter_delta.description: With semantic_parameter, change from its starting value in that parameter's native units; displacement is still required.

actions.name: manipulation_guidance
actions.label: Evaluate manipulation guidance
actions.description: Evaluate manipulation guidance.

input_schema.description: Physics-guided manipulation query.

actions.name: manipulation_commit
actions.label: Commit direct geometry manipulation
actions.description: Commit direct geometry manipulation.

input_schema.description: Persist and close this gesture. Supply the latest accepted preview sequence as final_sequence to prevent committing an older preview.

actions.name: manipulation_cancel
actions.label: Cancel direct geometry manipulation
actions.description: Cancel direct geometry manipulation.

input_schema.description: Restore the exact gesture-start model and close the session without committing the preview.

actions.name: manipulation_undo
actions.label: Undo direct geometry manipulation
actions.description: Undo direct geometry manipulation.

actions.name: manipulation_redo
actions.label: Redo direct geometry manipulation
actions.description: Redo direct geometry manipulation.

actions.name: inspect_geometry_kinds
actions.label: Inspect geometry feature kinds
actions.description: Read registered geometry types, parameter units, defaults, and field classes.

actions.name: inspect_model_document
actions.label: Inspect complete geometry document
actions.description: Read the current model or a saved epoch without applying it. The default document limit is 16 MiB.

actions.name: evaluate_geometry
actions.label: Evaluate implicit geometry
actions.description: Calculate an implicit field at points or a cubic grid. Supply points_mm or grid_n, not both. Supply bbox_mm for a grid. Units are millimeters. Optimization subtrees are rejected.

actions.name: export_geometry
actions.label: Export implicit solid geometry
actions.description: Export an implicit subtree with the native exporter. STEP contains planar facets of the sampled surface. Read sampling and mesh checks. This synchronous tool cannot be cancelled.

actions.name: check_gradients
actions.label: Check a design gradient
actions.description: Compare AD gradients with central finite differences for a run request. This can require several physics solves. No optimization starts. Zero directions do not verify nonzero gradients. This synchronous tool cannot be cancelled.

actions.name: render_mesh_scene
actions.label: Render imported mesh scene
actions.description: Render a native scene from inline binary STL data. Closed, consistently oriented manifold meshes are required for capped cuts. File paths are not accepted. This synchronous tool cannot be cancelled.

actions.name: inspect_imported_providers
actions.label: Inspect imported physics providers
actions.description: Read optional external providers and their declared limits.

actions.name: import_physics_provider
actions.label: Import physics provider
actions.description: Load a local adapter and model manifest. This starts the declared executable. Select it separately for optimization.

actions.name: remove_physics_provider
actions.label: Remove imported physics provider
actions.description: Remove an optional provider when no job owns its physics state.

actions.name: check_imported_provider
actions.label: Check imported physics provider
actions.description: Check predictions and sampled design derivatives at the supplied state. Compare with the declared reference provider when available.

actions.name: import_mesh_geometry
actions.label: Import mesh as implicit geometry
actions.description: Convert a closed STL or PLY mesh to an implicit field. Set input units and sampling. Read interpolation checks before use.

actions.name: prepare_run_comparison
actions.label: Prepare saved-run comparison
actions.description: Prepare common saved epochs and native solid and complement views. The current model stays unchanged. No solve starts.

render_settings.description: Shared render settings. Source and region are assigned by the comparison.
